name: Runtime / Compute Environment
purpose: Represent governed runtime environments, infrastructure resources, dependent runtime-occupant records, configuration-control designations and temporal hosting topology without duplicating logical systems, deployment occurrences, asset records or tenant landscape facts.

owns: dependent runtime-occupant records for as-of hosting, never gold-copy subject identity
desired-versus-observed state correlation and retained drift
configuration-item designation under a named control authority
delegates: logical software-system and business-application identity to WM-SFT-002
deployment occurrence and placement outcome to WM-SFT-009
fact mastership and bounded impact projection semantics to WM-XCT-039
physical-item identity and asset evidence to WM-OBJ-001
financial asset and depreciation semantics to finance masters
excludes: a second logical Software System identity
DeployedInstance as an independent gold-copy master
network address as an eternal identifier
copy of financial or physical asset master
current topology represented as timeless truth
deletion or identifier reuse for ephemeral resources

RuntimeEnvironment.lifecycleSemantics: Lifecycle is reconstructed from effective-dated StatusAssertion records; retired requires retiredAt.

InfrastructureResource.lifecycleSemantics: resourceKind is enumerated; lifecycle is reconstructed from StatusAssertion; released requires releasedAt.

HostingRelation.closureRule: Supersession or withdrawal is represented by validTo plus a CorrectionRecord; functional relation kinds may not overlap without an explicit unresolved conflict.

ConfigurationItemDesignation.lifecycleSemantics: Effective while validFrom <= asOf < validTo or validTo is absent; withdrawal closes designation only.

StateAssertion.lifecycleSemantics: Corrections and supersession close effectiveTo and reference a CorrectionRecord; desired and observed assertions remain separate.

RuntimeOccupantRecord.identitySemantics: Dependent correlation record only; runtimeKey is unique within runtimeKeyAuthority and runtimeKeyScope for all retained time and is never reused locally.
RuntimeOccupantRecord.closureRule: terminalState requires observedTo; closure never mutates the referenced WM-SFT-002 or WM-SFT-009 subject.

StatusAssertion.lifecycleSemantics: All environment and resource lifecycle status is historical and as-of queryable.

SuccessionRelation.rule: Predecessor and successor identities differ; this relation never rewrites either record.

AssetResourceEvidenceLink.lifecycleSemantics: Append, supersede or close under the named evidence authority; the link never merges identities.

CorrectionRecord.rule: Correction is distinct from withdrawal and preserves the original record.

relations.purpose: Resolve the logical software system or business application without copying identity.
Resolve the deployment occurrence that created or changed deployed instances.
Reuse fact-mastership desired-versus-observed and bounded impact projection rules.
Resolve an underlying physical item while preserving separate CI and asset lifecycles.

operations.effect: Register a governed environment subject; planned status needs no commissionedAt.
Register a capacity-bearing resource with one enumerated resourceKind.
Append a dependent runtime observation bound to one WM-SFT-002 subject, one WM-SFT-009 occurrence and one immutable artifact version.
Append a typed temporal edge whose endpoints satisfy hostingEndpointRules.
Append an effective-dated status assertion; terminal status requires the subject close timestamp.
Append desired, observed or inferred state while retaining drift.
operations.authority: declared master for the fact path

operations.effect: Place an eligible referenced subject under configuration control for a validity period.
Append an effective-dated AssetResourceEvidenceLink without merging identities.
Append a dated, sourced and evidenced predecessor-successor relation.
Append a CorrectionRecord and close or replace the target without deleting it.

invariants: WM-SFT-002 logical identity is invariant under deployment, hosting, scaling, region and node replacement.
WM-SFT-009 owns deployment occurrence and desired placement; WM-SFT-010 owns observed environment, resource and hosting facts.
A RuntimeOccupantRecord depends on exactly one WM-SFT-002 subject, one WM-SFT-009 occurrence and one immutable artifact version.
RuntimeOccupantRecord is never an independent gold-copy subject.
runtimeKey is unique for all retained time within runtimeKeyAuthority plus runtimeKeyScope; local ingestion rejects reuse.
Every InfrastructureResource has one enumerated resourceKind.
Every resource participating in environment topology has exactly one non-overlapping contained-in relation at an as-of instant.
An occupant runs only on a resource contained in the occupant environment at the same as-of instant.
Cluster member-of and occupant runs-on are distinct temporal relations.
Functional runs-on and contained-in relations do not overlap for the same subject unless an unresolved conflict is explicitly retained.
Current topology and status are as-of projections of effective-dated records, never timeless stored truth.
Planned environment or resource records do not require commissioning or provisioning timestamps.
Retired, released, stopped, superseded and withdrawn records require their applicable close timestamp.
Environment and cluster identity remain independent of member resources.
Node replacement creates a new resource identifier, closes old intervals and adds a dated evidenced SuccessionRelation.
Address or hostname is an effective-dated observation and never identity.
Desired, observed and inferred StateAssertions remain separate and drift is retained.
A CI designation does not duplicate its subject; withdrawal closes the designation and never destroys the subject.
Only explicitly eligible subject types may receive a ConfigurationItemDesignation.
Configuration-control authority exists only on the effective-dated designation plane.
Asset, resource and CI designation never share identity.
Asset-resource linkage exists only through AssetResourceEvidenceLink and requires dated evidence.
Corrections append CorrectionRecord and preserve the original record; correction is distinct from withdrawal.
Every observation carries source and recorded time plus method and effective or observed time as applicable.
Missing or stale observation means unknown rather than absent.
Impact answers are time-qualified and state their completeness boundary.
Region, environment, cluster, node and runtime occupant layers are never flattened into one identity.
holds: Frozen audit completed with deterministic remediation; audit is not rerun.
WM-SFT-002 migration and WM-SFT-009/WM-XCT-039 publication holds remain external.
Artifact-version and financial-asset bindings require their domain registries.
A governing tombstone-retention policy must be pinned before a finite historical guarantee is claimed.
Package conversion and live HTTP/runtime/search/package verification are pending.

mastership.observedHosting: authorizedTopologySourceRef pinned for the environment and relation kind

identityStack: region is a classification or external jurisdiction/placement reference, never environment identity
RuntimeEnvironment is the governed regional or isolation context
InfrastructureResource:cluster is a stable logical capacity subject
InfrastructureResource:node is a non-recycled member subject
RuntimeOccupantRecord is a dependent observation bound to WM-SFT-002 and WM-SFT-009

assetEvidenceContract.rule: Only the first-class link carries asset-resource evidence; ConfigurationItemDesignation has no asset field and identities never merge.

tombstonePolicy.rule: Closed subjects and runtime keys remain as-of queryable for the retention period named by the governing policy; keys are never recycled.
tombstonePolicy.unknownPolicyEffect: Retention is pending and publication cannot claim unbounded history.
